meta.name: ad-account-auditor
meta.description: Use when auditing a paid ad account for ROAS quality, wasted spend, or measurement integrity before scaling; runs RQS scoring with veto checks and a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK gate on your own exported account data. Not for building campaign structure — use campaign-architect; not for creative units — use ad-creative-builder. 付费广告账户审计/ROAS评分

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计付费广告账户的ROAS质量与浪费支出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理付费广告账户并希望在扩量前评估投放质量。
copy.tagline_en: Audit paid ad accounts for ROAS quality and wasted spend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid ad accounts and want to evaluate campaign quality before scaling.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审计你提供的付费广告账户数据，对 ROAS 质量、浪费的支出和衡量完整性进行评分，并给出“放行/修复/阻止”的结论。
howto.when: 当你询问广告账户是否可以扩量、怀疑跟踪或归因有问题，或者在进行预算提升前，Claude 会触发审计。

say.text: 审计这个 Google Ads 账户的 ROAS，目标是 DR/效果。
在扩量前检查我的 Meta 账户，看看有没有衡量和归因问题。
say.note: Claude 会检查 R1/R2 等否决项并给出结论。

say.text: 运行广告账户审计，这是搜索词报告和 GA4 流量获取导出。
say.note: Claude 会基于你提供的数据进行评分和否决检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude audits your paid ad account data, scoring ROAS quality, wasted spend, and measurement integrity, then outputs a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask if an account is ready to scale, suspect tracking or attribution issues, or before raising budgets.

say_en.text: Audit this Google Ads account for ROAS. Goal is DR/performance.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for campaign export, GA4 conversions export, etc.

say_en.text: Check my Meta account for measurement and attribution problems before I scale.
say_en.note: Claude checks R1/R2 vetoes and gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Run an ad-account audit. Here's the search-terms report and GA4 export.
say_en.note: Claude scores and veto-checks based on your data.
